title: Public Notice: Scheduled Server Maintenance on e-Mahabhumi Portal
content: Portal services will be intermittently unavailable on Sunday from 01:00 AM to 05:00 AM IST for cadastral database index re-indexing.

title: Advisory: Link Mobile Number & Aadhaar with Form 8A Khata
content: All landholders are urged to verify their e-KYC to receive instant SMS and email notifications upon any mutation application.

title: Gazette: Revision of Agricultural Land Revenue Rates (Akar) for FY 2025-26
content: Revised revenue assessment challans are now accessible through the Online Land Revenue Payment portal.

title: Caution Notice: Beware of Fraudulent Third-Party Extract Portals
content: Official digitally signed extracts must only be downloaded from Land Stack or verified official gov.in domains.

title: Circular: Verification of Non-Agricultural Land Use Permissions
content: All developers must submit verified ULPIN in layout sanction applications to PMRDA and PMC.

title: Notice: Form 135D Statutory Objection Window Protocol
content: Objections to provisional pencil entries must be submitted with certified documentary evidence within 15 days.

title: Order: Mandatory Inspection Protocol for SRO e-Registration Linkage
content: Sub-Registrars must ensure ULPIN biometric verification before executing conveyancing deeds.

title: Notification: Special Lok Adalat for Revenue Dispute Redressal
content: Special revenue benches to be convened on 12-March-2025 for expedited compromise in pending partition matters.
